name: dYdX
rootCause: Twitter netizen "mhonkasalo" stated that there was a bug in the dYdX pledge contract. The user received 0 stkDYDX when pledged, the front end was disabled, and there were 64 affected addresses. Later, dYdX released the "Pledge Contract Bug" incident report. During the deployment of the upgradeable smart contract, the dYdX security module made an error, which caused the ratio of DYDX to stkDYDX to change from 1 to 0, so that users who pledged DYDX did not receive stkDYDX. dYdX stated that the error was caused by an error in the smart contract deployment process.
